thread:
samir_ops: FYI vendor (GigaSupply) just sent an updated shipping window for the H100 allocation. They moved 30 units into an earlier wave (ETA 2025-02-18) but flagged 10 as pending RMA hold.

esther_prod: Thanks — which region are the 30 moving earlier to? we need them in eu-west for the new cluster.

samir_ops: 20 -> eu-west, 10 -> us-west. the 10 on hold are showing 'DOA audit' with vendor note: 'pending serial swap & customs doc'.

marco_sourcing: Did they give any price delta for splitting the wave? we might need to accept a small uplift for expedited crossdock.

samir_ops: Quote shows +5% for early split + freight uplift. i've asked for firm AWB and insured value.

ops-bot: Ticket created: INF-4821 — vendor-split + rma-hold. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4821

katie_support: For the RMA hold units, can we request a temporary loaner pool while vendor processes serial swap? last time that reduced outage risk.

samir_ops: Good call. i've asked GigaSupply about short-term loaners. they replied: 'can provide up to 8 temporary units (2-week loan) from our depot, subject to depot availability and separate LOA.'

esther_prod: If we take loaners, we should pin cluster allocation so autoscaler doesn't steal capacity from prod. Add a tag: `reserve:vendor-loaner` on the nodes.

marco_sourcing: Also ask vendor for RMA SLA: turnaround days and if they cover return freight. we need that to calculate total landed cost.

samir_ops: They answered in email: "RMA TAT 7-10 business days for serial swaps; return freight covered if DOA; customs clearance is client's responsibility for re-exports." attached snippet:```
RMA-ID: GS-RMA-2025-887
Units: 10
Reason: DOA audit
TAT: 7-10bd
Loaner: up to 8 units (2 weeks)
```

katie_support: Note that customs re-export is messy in eu-west. we should engage customs broker now — recommend LumenFreight; anyone object?

esther_prod: +1 for LumenFreight, they handled our last crossdock well. Also we need to scope fallback model routing in the console (route to smaller model variant if capacity dips).

marco_sourcing: On pricing: firm uplift is 5% expedited + $1200 per unit loaner handling if we use depot loaners. If we skip loaners we save handling but risk delayed rollout.

samir_ops: Decision needed by EOD to lock AWB and loaner pickup window. options: A) accept split + loaners (pay uplift + handling), B) accept split no loaners, C) keep original schedule and wait (risk longer lead).

katie_support: Ops preference = A. minimizes customer-impact.

esther_prod: Agree A. i'll update rollout plan and toggle canary to 10% until loaners returned.

ops-bot: INF-4821 updated: decision=A, finance tag added, assigned to marco_sourcing.

marco_sourcing: I'll confirm with GigaSupply and ask for consolidated invoice + AWB numbers. Also asked them to include Huawei-free certificate for customs (we had a hiccup last time).

samir_ops: Thanks. once i have AWB i'll post pickup window and RMA instruction to oncall. quick reminder for oncall: create `rma-return-label` task and set `priority: express` if vendor marks DOA.

katie_support: copying the logistics checklist we used previously:```
- Confirm AWB and insured value
- Create RMA case with vendor and attach photos
- Initiate loaner pickup window (48h notice)
- Engage customs broker for re-export docs
- Tag nodes `reserve:vendor-loaner` and adjust autoscaler
- Finance: expect +5% uplift + handling fees
```

samir_ops: Perfect. i'll follow up with vendor now and update INF-4821 with AWB when they send it. :thumbsup:

esther_prod: appreciate it — looping in infra oncall once AWB is posted.

marco_sourcing: pinging them now. if they push back on loaner fees i'll negotiate to waive handling for the first 4 units. will update here.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up in 12 hours for AWB check.
